caseStudy.blurb: I represented Agility at the photoshoot for TIME's Best Inventions of 2024 issue, featuring our humanoid robot, Digit. While on-site in Santa Fe, I provided input on strategies for effectively photographing the robot while staying true to Agility's brand identity. This resulting photo by [Jo Whaley](https://www.jowhaley.com/) was ultimately chosen as the cover for the issue.
